title: The journey, feats and shade
notes: The journey: eight beacons, one per sky, that burn as you relight them. The sky you light ignites on the summit card.
Feats: medals for first light, a true column, beating your ghost, a top-ten board placing and more.
A calmer summit card: the stars, the numbers, the purse and the forge, in that order, one beat at a time.
Throw shade: beat the person you compete with and tell them. They get a mark on that sky, and can race you straight back.
This window. Builds announce themselves here, and tell you what is in them.
